# HMAC generator / verifier

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/hmac-generator/

Calculate or verify a SHA-256 or SHA-512 HMAC using a text or hexadecimal key through your browser’s cryptographic API.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Compare HMAC output before and after adding a newline to a sample message.

## Limits and checks

HMAC is authentication with a shared secret, not encryption or a public-key signature. Avoid using production secrets in untrusted pages or screenshots.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
